verdict.rationale: Loops documents the core campaign loop. Its marketing-email docs list creating a campaign, building an audience segment, and sending a newsletter. It has a visual editor with brand styles, and draft campaigns can be reviewed and sent from the dashboard. Segments are dynamic, and community users describe the product as easy to use. missing for 10: explicit evidence of scheduling a campaign for later, detailed docs on selecting a segment or list as a campaign's audience, and independent hands-on corroboration of the send flow.
